subject: MedX: On-prem deployment — MSA & Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@medxhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medxhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redlines to MSA + Order Form for on-prem deployment

Vivek —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our legal team has completed an initial pass on the MSA and the Order Form tied to the on-prem deployment. Attached are our annotated redlines (MedX_Redlines_v1.docx). High-level asks:

- Operator access: carve out for limited witness/testing access is acceptable, but we need stronger language around operational handback and proof of non-access (audit trail requirement).
- Evidence delivery cadence: we prefer a 90-day snapshot deposit and quarterly attestation versus a one-time escrow.
- Custody/keys: we want assurance around key custody and an optional KMS integration; if Redwood retains keys, we need a documented HSM/KMS proof flow.
- Audit window: proposal of two business‑day response for evidence access requests during an audit window; please confirm availability model.

We'd like to schedule a short legal sync to go through these items and align on language before redlining the exhibits. Is there someone on your side who can take the lead on evidence logistics and provide a strawman timeline?

Attachments: MedX_Redlines_v1.docx (document)

— Amelia Turner
Senior Counsel, MedX Health
amelia.turner@medxhealth.com
+1 415-555-0132
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@medxhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redlines to MSA + Order Form for on-prem deployment

Amelia —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear notes. I’ve looped in Neha (legal) and David (enterprise lead) and Jordan (ops) so we can coordinate the language and operational plan. Initial thoughts / proposed next steps:

1) Evidence and snapshot cadence: we can produce a 90-day snapshot and provide quarterly attestations. Jordan will confirm storage and rotation cadence and whether a witness-lite staging is feasible.

2) Operator access: Redwood’s standard approach is limited, logged access for debugging only, and only by named, vetted operators with MFA + bastion logging. Neha — can you propose short, firm language for the MSA that preserves security while giving MedX the witness/fraud proof you need?

3) KMS/key custody: we support both customer-managed KMS and Redwood-managed HSM. We’ll propose both exhibit paths (customer KMS preferred for sovereignty).

4) Audit response SLA: two business days for initial acknowledgement is fine; full evidence response timeline will depend on the artifact requested — propose an SLA table in the Order Form exhibit.

I attached a brief runbook outline that maps who owns which artifact and the expected delivery window. If that looks okay, we’ll produce suggested MSA language and an exhibit with sample SLAs and a custody flow.

Proposed: 30-min legal sync Thursday 9/21 at 11:00am PT. Does that work for you?

Attachments: Initial_Runbook_Outline.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@medxhealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redlines to MSA + Order Form for on-prem deployment

Amelia / Vivek —

Thanks — I reviewed MedX’s annotated redlines and sketched out our position on the hotspots. Below are bite-sized replies I can convert into redline text for the MSA and an Order Form exhibit. I’ve also linked the HubSpot deal and a draft drive folder in case you want to pull artifacts.

Quick positions (we should keep these concise in the MSA, move operational detail to an exhibit):

- Operator access: Redwood will accept a "witness-lite" model: no shell access to customer VMs; operator sessions limited to pre-approved troubleshooting scripts and fully audited. We will push for operator access to be triggered only after a documented incident or support request, with customer notification. Proposed exhibit will include: named operator list, MFA requirement, bastion logging URL, and periodic witness demo windows.

- Snapshots & escrow-like artifacts: Redwood can provide encrypted snapshots and a documented transfer protocol. We prefer quarterly snapshot delivery with a 90-day retention hold for audit events. If MedX requires a long-term deposit in escrow, we will propose a mutually agreeable certified custodian approach (costs to customer).

- Key custody: Offer two options in the Order Form exhibit: (A) customer-managed KMS integration (preferred); (B) Redwood-managed HSM with dual-control attestations. If (B) chosen, include HSM audit report references and monthly attestations.

- Evidence SLA: Accept 2 business day acknowledgement; full response times depend on artifact complexity. Recommend an SLA table: acknowledgement (2bd), evidence triage (5bd), complete artifact delivery (15bd). We can carve faster SLOs for urgent compliance incidents.

Next steps I can take this afternoon: draft MSA language for operator access clause, draft exhibit for evidence & custody options, and propose a short SLA table. Vivek / David / Jordan — if you have operational constraints or cost concerns, flag them now so I can bake the tradeoffs into the exhibit.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/78321 | Draft drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEfGhIjK

— Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@medxhealth.com>

Date: 2026-09-21T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redlines to MSA + Order Form for on-prem deployment

Neha / Vivek —

This is helpful, thank you. Thursday 9/21 11:00am PT works for our counsel (we booked it). Two quick clarifications before the call:

1) Snapshot cadence: MedX prefers a 90-day primary retention but wants an option to request a longer-term deposit for e-discovery. Will Redwood include a priced option for a certified custodian escrow? If so, can you include a short sample clause?

2) Evidence SLA table: the triage/complete timelines look reasonable. Can you include a line for "forensic snapshot creation" (we propose 7 business days when requested under an audit)?

I attached our annotated Order Form for reference. Please share the draft exhibit and short MSA paragraph before the call so counsel can prep.

Attachments: MedX_OrderForm_annotated.pdf (pdf)

See you on the call.
— Amelia
